## Overview

Add `AiterW4A16LinearKernel`, an `MPLinearKernel` that runs int4 weight-only linears (GPTQ, AWQ, compressed-tensors W4A16) on MI300 (gfx942) with AITER's Triton `gemm_a16w4` (ROCm/aiter#6778, merged). It is registered ahead of `TritonW4A16LinearKernel` and used when `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` (with the default `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR=1`) and the installed AITER provides `gemm_a16w4`. AWQ checkpoints on ROCm are routed to the `MPLinearKernel` path when this kernel is enabled.

Related: #34008 (W4A16 GEMM kernels for AMD, closed as stale). This supersedes #42640 (`CDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel`, a new Triton kernel for the same slot; stale, needs rebase): it reuses AITER's tuned kernel instead of adding one to vLLM, and covers AWQ. #62736 (split-K tiles for `TritonW4A16LinearKernel` on gfx950) does not conflict: it changes only the gfx950 Triton path.

## Claims

On one MI300X with AITER on, existing kernel vs this PR (medians; full tables under Validation):

| Model | Metric | Before | This PR | Change |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4 | Decode TPOT | 19.62 ms | **3.83 ms** | **5.1x faster** |
|  | Batch-1 latency (512 in / 256 out) | 5.00 s | **0.97 s** | **5.2x faster** |
|  | Output throughput, concurrency 64 | 2,696 tok/s | **6,728 tok/s** | **2.5x higher** |
|  | GSM8K strict / flexible (250) | 0.720 / 0.828 | **0.716 / 0.828** | same (±1 of 250) |
| Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4 | Decode TPOT | 67.52 ms | **13.73 ms** | **4.9x faster** |
|  | Batch-1 latency (512 in / 256 out) | 17.35 s | **3.59 s** | **4.8x faster** |
|  | Output throughput, concurrency 64 | 778 tok/s | **1,544 tok/s** | **2.0x higher** |
| Qwen3-8B-AWQ ¹ | Decode TPOT | 10.81 ms | **4.75 ms** | **2.3x faster** |
|  | Batch-1 latency (512 in / 256 out) | 2.74 s | **1.22 s** | **2.2x faster** |
|  | Output throughput, concurrency 64 | 4,030 tok/s | **4,727 tok/s** | **1.2x higher** |
|  | GSM8K strict / flexible (250) | 0.908 / 0.920 | **0.912 / 0.924** | same (±1 of 250) |

¹ AWQ baseline is the current ROCm AWQ path (`AutoAWQLinearMethod`, Triton AWQ GEMM); GPTQ baselines are `TritonW4A16LinearKernel`.

No change when AITER is off, when the installed AITER lacks `gemm_a16w4` (e.g. v0.1.26, the version vLLM pins today), on other archs, or with `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`: selection falls through to the existing kernels.

## Validation

### Kernel (`gemm_a16w4` vs `triton_w4a16_gemm`, MI300X, Triton 3.8)

Geomean over the 8 linear shapes of Llama-3-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, bf16, symmetric group 128, cold weights (HIP graph cycling 1 GB of weight copies), 3 alternating rounds. Speedup = other / `gemm_a16w4` time.

| M | vs TritonW4A16 | vs Conch | vs hipBLASLt BF16 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 7.98x | 12.2x | 1.36x |
| 16 | 7.63x | 11.8x | 1.31x |
| 64 | 4.02x | 7.2x | 1.09x |
| 256 | 3.27x | 3.5x | 0.84x |
| 1024 | 1.62x | 2.4x | 0.68x |
| 4096 | 1.51x | 2.7x | 0.69x |

Configurations alternate within each repetition; medians of 3 repetitions (7B), 2 (AWQ, 32B). Cells: output tok/s / median TTFT ms / median TPOT ms.

A = default (AITER off). A2 = AITER on, this kernel disabled with `VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=AiterW4A16LinearKernel`. B = AITER on (this PR). C = BF16 model, AITER on.

**Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4** (fp16)

| | kernel | latency b1 / b8 (s) | c=1 | c=8 | c=32 | c=64 | GSM8K strict / flex |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | TritonW4A16 | 5.02 / 5.33 | 51 / 30 / 19.64 | 382 / 164 / 20.31 | 1393 / 190 / 21.38 | 2692 / 253 / 21.12 | 0.720 / 0.828 |
| A2 | TritonW4A16 | 5.00 / 5.33 | 51 / 30 / 19.62 | 383 / 206 / 20.36 | 1397 / 190 / 21.27 | 2696 / 236 / 21.10 | 0.720 / 0.828 |
| B | AiterW4A16 | 0.97 / 1.25 | 258 / 15 / 3.83 | 1644 / 156 / 4.29 | 4125 / 117 / 5.28 | 6728 / 188 / 8.51 | 0.716 / 0.828 |
| C | BF16 | 1.11 / 1.50 | 226 / 14 / 4.39 | 1345 / 62 / 5.60 | 4377 / 81 / 6.59 | 6942 / 158 / 8.42 | 0.784 / 0.844 |

**Qwen3-8B-AWQ** (asymmetric uint4, bf16)

| | kernel | latency b1 / b8 (s) | c=1 | c=8 | c=32 | c=64 | GSM8K strict / flex |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | AutoAWQLinearMethod (Triton AWQ) | 2.74 / 2.92 | 92 / 20 / 10.81 | 699 / 90 / 11.03 | 2461 / 130 / 12.06 | 4030 / 222 / 14.87 | 0.908 / 0.920 |
| A2 | TritonW4A16 | 5.80 / 6.13 | 44 / 33 / 22.68 | 333 / 159 / 23.36 | 1197 / 194 / 24.94 | 2441 / 267 / 23.38 | 0.908 / 0.920 |
| B | AiterW4A16 | 1.22 / 1.58 | 208 / 15 / 4.75 | 1281 / 116 / 5.51 | 3114 / 147 / 7.56 | 4727 / 219 / 11.72 | 0.912 / 0.924 |
| C | BF16 | 1.21 / 1.69 | 209 / 17 / 4.74 | 1196 / 78 / 6.29 | 3643 / 98 / 8.07 | 5503 / 171 / 10.85 | 0.904 / 0.908 |

**Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4** (fp16)

| | kernel | latency b1 / b8 (s) | c=1 | c=8 | c=32 | c=64 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A2 | TritonW4A16 | 17.35 / 18.67 | 15 / 83 / 67.52 | 110 / 837 / 70.26 | 396 / 424 / 73.64 | 778 / 585 / 68.81 |
| B | AiterW4A16 | 3.59 / 4.87 | 73 / 27 / 13.73 | 446 / 804 / 15.48 | 1170 / 267 / 20.70 | 1544 / 475 / 31.27 |

The end-to-end decode gain matches the kernel numbers: for Qwen2.5-7B in fp16 at M = 1, the summed linear-layer time over 28 layers is 18.7 ms (TritonW4A16) vs 2.2 ms (`gemm_a16w4`), a 16.5 ms difference; the measured TPOT difference is 15.8 ms.

Re-run with the final version of this PR (Qwen2.5-7B-GPTQ, A2 vs B, 2 repetitions): TPOT 19.67 -> 3.82 ms, concurrency 64 2698 -> 6689 tok/s, batch-1 latency 5.02 -> 0.97 s, GSM8K B 0.712 / 0.824 (A2 0.720 / 0.828). With the warmup (4 weight shapes x 28 M values; 31.6 s cold, 0.2 s with a warm Triton cache), the JIT monitor reported no `_gemm_a16w4_kernel` compilation during serving or latency runs, for GPTQ and AWQ. With stock AITER v0.1.26 and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, GPTQ selects `TritonW4A16LinearKernel` and AWQ stays on `AutoAWQLinearMethod`, and both serve normally.

Compile cache, same image, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, Qwen2.5-7B-GPTQ, persistent `~/.cache/vllm`: without the hash change, a cache built with stock AITER v0.1.26 (TritonW4A16) was loaded after adding `gemm_a16w4` and the server failed at startup (`AssertionError: expected size 4608==3584`). With it, stock and `gemm_a16w4` builds get different AOT cache entries; switching stock -> `gemm_a16w4` -> stock -> `gemm_a16w4` starts and serves each time (TritonW4A16 / AiterW4A16 / TritonW4A16 / AiterW4A16), reusing the matching entry on the second visit.

### Tests

```bash
# gfx942, AITER with gemm_a16w4, VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_aiter_w4a16.py \
  tests/kernels/quantization/test_w4a16_kernel_selection.py \
  tests/kernels/quantization/test_triton_w4a16.py \
  "tests/quantization/test_auto_awq.py::test_auto_awq_rocm_routes_to_mp_linear_with_aiter_w4a16"
# 131 passed
# same with stock AITER v0.1.26 (no gemm_a16w4): test_aiter_w4a16.py skips; 6 passed, 1 skipped
# without VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER: test_w4a16_kernel_selection.py 4 passed
```

`test_aiter_w4a16.py` checks the kernel against a fp32 reference through `process_weights_after_loading` + `apply_weights` for the GPTQ/AWQ layout (`[K // 8, N]`) and the compressed-tensors layout (`[N, K // 8]`), uint4b8 and uint4, groups -1/32/128, fp16/bf16, M = 1/16/33/256 with bias; the fake impl under `make_fx`; `can_implement` (group sizes, quant types, batch-invariant mode); and the warmup. `test_auto_awq.py` checks the ROCm AWQ routing and that Marlin verification is skipped only on that route. `test_w4a16_kernel_selection.py` also checks that the compile-cache factor agrees with the selection gate and that `KernelConfig.compute_hash` changes with it.

Test environment: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-df6603f0583375f244d1ac6d36265462b7490392` (torch 2.13 + ROCm 10.0, Triton 3.8.0+git669b31ac, AITER v0.1.26) with this PR applied, and the files added by ROCm/aiter#6778 (`gemm_a16w4` wrapper, kernel and gfx942/gfx1100 configs, from aiter b818d3571) copied into the installed AITER v0.1.26. The PR adds files only; their dependencies exist in v0.1.26. The kernel table above was measured with AITER at #6778 on torch 2.10 + ROCm 7.0, Triton 3.8.0.

## Details

- **Kernel.** The GPTQ, AWQ (after `_convert_awq_to_standard_format`) and compressed-tensors loaders hand `MPLinearKernel`s int32 words that hold 8 sequential K values. That is `gemm_a16w4`'s weight layout viewed as uint8, so `process_weights_after_loading` only permutes the weight to `[N, K // 8]`, keeps scales as `[N, K // G]` in the activation dtype, and unpacks zero points to uint8 `[N, K // G]`; no weight copy beyond the permutation. uint4b8 uses the kernel's default zero point 8.
- **Gating.** `rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_w4a16_enabled()` = `is_linear_enabled()` (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER` and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR`) and gfx942 and `gemm_a16w4` importable. The importability check follows the existing `_gdn_triton_kernels_importable` / `_kda_gluon_decode_importable` pattern (cached guarded import). gfx942 only: of the archs vLLM builds AITER for, only gfx942 has tuned configs (AITER also ships gfx1100 configs; see Limitations). `VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=AiterW4A16LinearKernel` disables it.
- **Custom op.** The GEMM runs as `torch.ops.vllm.rocm_aiter_gemm_a16w4` with a fake impl; it works with `VLLM_COMPILE` and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE CUDA graphs (all runs above).
- **Warmup.** AITER picks a config per power-of-two M bucket and Triton specializes M on 1 and multiples of 16. CUDA graph capture covers only decode sizes, so without a warmup the first prefill in a new bucket compiled the kernel during serving (reported by the JIT monitor). `aiter_w4a16_warmup` runs from `kernel_warmup` (when `enable_jit_warmup`) and calls each distinct layer shape once per bucket (M = 2^k and 2^k - 1, up to `max_num_batched_tokens`).
- **Batch invariance.** AITER's tuned `BLOCK_SIZE_K` and split-K change with the M bucket, so `can_implement` rejects the kernel under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT`, which keeps the existing path (as `mxfp4/aiter.py` does for its split-K path).
- **AWQ routing.** On ROCm, `AutoAWQConfig` always used `AutoAWQLinearMethod` (Triton AWQ GEMM), so AWQ never reached the `MPLinearKernel` registry. When `is_linear_w4a16_enabled()`, it now returns `AutoAWQMarlinLinearMethod` (the generic `choose_mp_linear_kernel` path, already used on CPU/XPU) and skips the Marlin capability check on that route only. With the gate off, ROCm AWQ behavior is unchanged.
- **Compile cache.** The selected kernel changes the weight layout the compiled graph sees, but the torch.compile cache key did not record it: with the same vLLM version and settings, installing or removing an AITER build with `gemm_a16w4` loaded a graph compiled for the other layout and failed at startup (`AssertionError: expected size 4608==3584` in the compiled graph). `KernelConfig.compute_hash` now includes `rocm_aiter_ops.linear_w4a16_compile_factor()` on ROCm. That factor is HIP-free (it checks the env/arch gate and that `aiter/ops/triton/gemm/basic/gemm_a16w4.py` exists via `find_spec`, without importing aiter), because config hashes are also computed in the API server process and importing aiter initializes HIP. A test checks that it agrees with the selection gate and that the hash changes with it.
- **Dependency.** vLLM pins AITER v0.1.26, which predates ROCm/aiter#6778, so the kernel stays inactive in the current image until the AITER pin includes it. This PR does not bump AITER.

### Limitations

- gfx942 only. On gfx1100 (W7900) `gemm_a16w4` is 1.1-2.1x faster than `RDNA3W4A16LinearKernel` for M >= 8 but 0.7-0.95x at M <= 4, and vLLM does not build AITER for gfx1100; not enabled there. gfx950 has no AITER configs.
- Compared with the BF16 model (config C), not the existing int4 path: at concurrency <= 8 the int4 model with this kernel matches or beats BF16 (Qwen2.5-7B TPOT 3.83 vs 4.39 ms, concurrency-8 throughput 1644 vs 1345 tok/s; Qwen3-8B-AWQ 1281 vs 1196 tok/s). At concurrency 32-64, BF16 has 3-6% higher throughput for Qwen2.5-7B and 16-17% for Qwen3-8B-AWQ, and lower TTFT from concurrency 8 on (Qwen2.5-7B 62/81/158 vs 156/117/188 ms at 8/32/64). The cause is prefill-sized GEMMs: for M >= 256 the kernel runs at 0.68-0.85x of dense hipBLASLt BF16. Routing large M to a dequantize-to-BF16 + hipBLASLt path would be a natural follow-up; this PR does not change prefill routing.

Re-run with the final version of this PR (Qwen2.5-7B-GPTQ, A2 vs B, 2 repetitions): TPOT 19.67 -> 3.82 ms, concurrency 64 2698 -> 6689 tok/s, batch-1 latency 5.02 -> 0.97 s, GSM8K B 0.712 / 0.824 (A2 0.720 / 0.828). With the warmup (4 weight shapes x 28 M values; 31.6 s cold, 0.2 s with a warm Triton cache), the JIT monitor reported no `_gemm_a16w4_kernel` compilation during serving or latency runs, for GPTQ and AWQ. With stock AITER v0.1.26 and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, GPTQ selects `TritonW4A16LinearKernel` and AWQ stays on `AutoAWQLinearMethod`, and both serve normally.

Compile cache, same image, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, Qwen2.5-7B-GPTQ, persistent `~/.cache/vllm`: without the hash change, a cache built with stock AITER v0.1.26 (TritonW4A16) was loaded after adding `gemm_a16w4` and the server failed at startup (`AssertionError: expected size 4608==3584`). With it, stock and `gemm_a16w4` builds get different AOT cache entries; switching stock -> `gemm_a16w4` -> stock -> `gemm_a16w4` starts and serves each time (TritonW4A16 / AiterW4A16 / TritonW4A16 / AiterW4A16), reusing the matching entry on the second visit.

### Tests

```bash
# gfx942, AITER with gemm_a16w4, VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_aiter_w4a16.py \
  tests/kernels/quantization/test_w4a16_kernel_selection.py \
  tests/kernels/quantization/test_triton_w4a16.py \
  "tests/quantization/test_auto_awq.py::test_auto_awq_rocm_routes_to_mp_linear_with_aiter_w4a16"
# 131 passed
# same with stock AITER v0.1.26 (no gemm_a16w4): test_aiter_w4a16.py skips; 6 passed, 1 skipped
# without VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER: test_w4a16_kernel_selection.py 4 passed
```

`test_aiter_w4a16.py` checks the kernel against a fp32 reference through `process_weights_after_loading` + `apply_weights` for the GPTQ/AWQ layout (`[K // 8, N]`) and the compressed-tensors layout (`[N, K // 8]`), uint4b8 and uint4, groups -1/32/128, fp16/bf16, M = 1/16/33/256 with bias; the fake impl under `make_fx`; `can_implement` (group sizes, quant types, batch-invariant mode); and the warmup. `test_auto_awq.py` checks the ROCm AWQ routing and that Marlin verification is skipped only on that route. `test_w4a16_kernel_selection.py` also checks that the compile-cache factor agrees with the selection gate and that `KernelConfig.compute_hash` changes with it.

Test environment: `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-df6603f0583375f244d1ac6d36265462b7490392` (torch 2.13 + ROCm 10.0, Triton 3.8.0+git669b31ac, AITER v0.1.26) with this PR applied, and the files added by ROCm/aiter#6778 (`gemm_a16w4` wrapper, kernel and gfx942/gfx1100 configs, from aiter b818d3571) copied into the installed AITER v0.1.26. The PR adds files only; their dependencies exist in v0.1.26. The kernel table above was measured with AITER at #6778 on torch 2.10 + ROCm 7.0, Triton 3.8.0.

## Details

- **Kernel.** The GPTQ, AWQ (after `_convert_awq_to_standard_format`) and compressed-tensors loaders hand `MPLinearKernel`s int32 words that hold 8 sequential K values. That is `gemm_a16w4`'s weight layout viewed as uint8, so `process_weights_after_loading` only permutes the weight to `[N, K // 8]`, keeps scales as `[N, K // G]` in the activation dtype, and unpacks zero points to uint8 `[N, K // G]`; no weight copy beyond the permutation. uint4b8 uses the kernel's default zero point 8.
- **Gating.** `rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_w4a16_enabled()` = `is_linear_enabled()` (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER` and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR`) and gfx942 and `gemm_a16w4` importable. The importability check follows the existing `_gdn_triton_kernels_importable` / `_kda_gluon_decode_importable` pattern (cached guarded import). gfx942 only: of the archs vLLM builds AITER for, only gfx942 has tuned configs (AITER also ships gfx1100 configs; see Limitations). `VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=AiterW4A16LinearKernel` disables it.
- **Custom op.** The GEMM runs as `torch.ops.vllm.rocm_aiter_gemm_a16w4` with a fake impl; it works with `VLLM_COMPILE` and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE CUDA graphs (all runs above).
- **Warmup.** AITER picks a config per power-of-two M bucket and Triton specializes M on 1 and multiples of 16. CUDA graph capture covers only decode sizes, so without a warmup the first prefill in a new bucket compiled the kernel during serving (reported by the JIT monitor). `aiter_w4a16_warmup` runs from `kernel_warmup` (when `enable_jit_warmup`) and calls each distinct layer shape once per bucket (M = 2^k and 2^k - 1, up to `max_num_batched_tokens`).
- **Batch invariance.** AITER's tuned `BLOCK_SIZE_K` and split-K change with the M bucket, so `can_implement` rejects the kernel under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT`, which keeps the existing path (as `mxfp4/aiter.py` does for its split-K path).
- **AWQ routing.** On ROCm, `AutoAWQConfig` always used `AutoAWQLinearMethod` (Triton AWQ GEMM), so AWQ never reached the `MPLinearKernel` registry. When `is_linear_w4a16_enabled()`, it now returns `AutoAWQMarlinLinearMethod` (the generic `choose_mp_linear_kernel` path, already used on CPU/XPU) and skips the Marlin capability check on that route only. With the gate off, ROCm AWQ behavior is unchanged.
- **Compile cache.** The selected kernel changes the weight layout the compiled graph sees, but the torch.compile cache key did not record it: with the same vLLM version and settings, installing or removing an AITER build with `gemm_a16w4` loaded a graph compiled for the other layout and failed at startup (`AssertionError: expected size 4608==3584` in the compiled graph). `KernelConfig.compute_hash` now includes `rocm_aiter_ops.linear_w4a16_compile_factor()` on ROCm. That factor is HIP-free (it checks the env/arch gate and that `aiter/ops/triton/gemm/basic/gemm_a16w4.py` exists via `find_spec`, without importing aiter), because config hashes are also computed in the API server process and importing aiter initializes HIP. A test checks that it agrees with the selection gate and that the hash changes with it.
- **Dependency.** vLLM pins AITER v0.1.26, which predates ROCm/aiter#6778, so the kernel stays inactive in the current image until the AITER pin includes it. This PR does not bump AITER.

### Limitations

- gfx942 only. On gfx1100 (W7900) `gemm_a16w4` is 1.1-2.1x faster than `RDNA3W4A16LinearKernel` for M >= 8 but 0.7-0.95x at M <= 4, and vLLM does not build AITER for gfx1100; not enabled there. gfx950 has no AITER configs.
- Compared with the BF16 model (config C), not the existing int4 path: at concurrency <= 8 the int4 model with this kernel matches or beats BF16 (Qwen2.5-7B TPOT 3.83 vs 4.39 ms, concurrency-8 throughput 1644 vs 1345 tok/s; Qwen3-8B-AWQ 1281 vs 1196 tok/s). At concurrency 32-64, BF16 has 3-6% higher throughput for Qwen2.5-7B and 16-17% for Qwen3-8B-AWQ, and lower TTFT from concurrency 8 on (Qwen2.5-7B 62/81/158 vs 156/117/188 ms at 8/32/64). The cause is prefill-sized GEMMs: for M >= 256 the kernel runs at 0.68-0.85x of dense hipBLASLt BF16. Routing large M to a dequantize-to-BF16 + hipBLASLt path would be a natural follow-up; this PR does not change prefill routing.

+"""Tests for the AITER W4A16 linear kernel (gfx942, aiter gemm_a16w4).

+Run `pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_aiter_w4a16.py`.
+"""

+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch._subclasses.fake_tensor import FakeTensorMode
+from torch.fx.experimental.proxy_tensor import make_fx
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+    pytest.skip("ROCm only", allow_module_level=True)

+from vllm._aiter_ops import (  # noqa: E402
+    is_aiter_found_and_supported,
+    rocm_aiter_ops,
+)

+    AiterW4A16LinearKernel,
+)

+    MPLinearLayerConfig,
+)

+from vllm.scalar_type import scalar_types  # noqa: E402
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_random_seed  # noqa: E402
+
+if not (
+    is_aiter_found_and_supported()
+    and rocm_aiter_ops._gemm_a16w4_importable()
+    and on_gfx942()
+):
+    pytest.skip(
+        "needs gfx942 and an AITER build with gemm_a16w4", allow_module_level=True
+    )
+
+device = "cuda"
+

+@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
+def _dist_init():
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.distributed import (
+        ensure_model_parallel_initialized,
+        init_distributed_environment,
+    )
+    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import model_parallel_is_initialized
+
+    if not model_parallel_is_initialized():
+        with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+            init_distributed_environment(
+                world_size=1,
+                rank=0,
+                distributed_init_method="tcp://127.0.0.1:0",
+                local_rank=0,
+            )
+            ensure_model_parallel_initialized(1, 1)
+
+
+def _pack8(v: torch.Tensor, dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pack int values 0..15 along `dim` (8 per int32, value i at bit 4*i)."""
+    v = v.movedim(dim, -1).to(torch.int64)
+    v = v.reshape(*v.shape[:-1], v.shape[-1] // 8, 8)
+    shifts = torch.arange(8, device=v.device, dtype=torch.int64) * 4
+    return (v << shifts).sum(-1).to(torch.int32).movedim(-1, dim).contiguous()
+
+
+def _config(K, N, G, weight_type, act_type, zero_points):
+    return MPLinearLayerConfig(
+        full_weight_shape=(K, N),
+        partition_weight_shape=(K, N),
+        weight_type=weight_type,
+        act_type=act_type,
+        group_size=G,
+        zero_points=zero_points,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_layer(fmt, q_kn, s_gn, z_gn):
+    """Register checkpoint tensors the way the loaders hand them to the kernel.
+
+    fmt="gptq": qweight [K//8, N] (packed_dim=0), scales [G, N] (GPTQ and AWQ
+    after _convert_awq_to_standard_format). fmt="ct": weight_packed [N, K//8]
+    (packed_dim=1), weight_scale [N, G], weight_zero_point [N//8, G].
+    """
+    from vllm.model_executor.parameter import (
+        GroupQuantScaleParameter,
+        PackedColumnParameter,
+        PackedvLLMParameter,
+    )
+
+    loader = lambda *args, **kwargs: None  # noqa: E731
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    if fmt == "gptq":
+        layer.register_parameter(
+            "w_q",
+            PackedvLLMParameter(
+                data=_pack8(q_kn, 0),
+                weight_loader=loader,
+                input_dim=0,
+                output_dim=1,
+                packed_dim=0,
+                packed_factor=8,
+            ),
+        )
+        layer.register_parameter(
+            "w_s",
+            GroupQuantScaleParameter(
+                data=s_gn.contiguous(), weight_loader=loader, input_dim=0, output_dim=1
+            ),
+        )
+    else:
+        layer.register_parameter(
+            "w_q",
+            PackedvLLMParameter(
+                data=_pack8(q_kn.t(), 1),
+                weight_loader=loader,
+                input_dim=1,
+                output_dim=0,
+                packed_dim=1,
+                packed_factor=8,
+            ),
+        )
+        layer.register_parameter(
+            "w_s",
+            GroupQuantScaleParameter(
+                data=s_gn.t().contiguous(),
+                weight_loader=loader,
+                input_dim=1,
+                output_dim=0,
+            ),
+        )
+    if z_gn is not None:
+        layer.register_parameter(
+            "w_zp",
+            PackedColumnParameter(
+                data=_pack8(z_gn.t(), 0),  # [N//8, G]
+                weight_loader=loader,
+                output_dim=0,
+                packed_dim=0,
+                packed_factor=8,
+            ),
+        )
+    return layer
+
+
+def test_gemm_a16w4_fake_impl():
+    with FakeTensorMode():
+        x = torch.empty((4, 256), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        w = torch.empty((512, 128), device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)
+        s = torch.empty((512, 2), device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        out = rocm_aiter_ops.gemm_a16w4(x, w, s, None, None)
+        assert out.shape == (4, 512) and out.dtype == x.dtype
+        graph = make_fx(lambda x, w, s: rocm_aiter_ops.gemm_a16w4(x, w, s))(x, w, s)
+    assert any(
+        node.op == "call_function"
+        and node.target == torch.ops.vllm.rocm_aiter_gemm_a16w4.default
+        for node in graph.graph.nodes
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["gptq", "ct"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("act_type", [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("weight_type", [scalar_types.uint4b8, scalar_types.uint4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("group_size", [-1, 32, 128])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("M", [1, 16, 33, 256])
+def test_aiter_w4a16_matches_reference(fmt, act_type, weight_type, group_size, M):
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    K, N = 512, 384
+    G = K if group_size == -1 else group_size
+    zero_points = weight_type == scalar_types.uint4
+    q = torch.randint(0, 16, (K, N), device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    s = (0.02 * torch.rand((K // G, N), device=device) + 0.002).to(act_type)
+    z = (
+        torch.randint(0, 16, (K // G, N), device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        if zero_points
+        else None
+    )
+    layer = _make_layer(fmt, q, s, z)
+    kernel = AiterW4A16LinearKernel(
+        _config(K, N, group_size, weight_type, act_type, zero_points),
+        w_q_param_name="w_q",
+        w_s_param_name="w_s",
+        w_zp_param_name="w_zp" if zero_points else None,
+    )
+    kernel.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    assert layer.w_q.dtype == torch.uint8 and tuple(layer.w_q.shape) == (N, K // 2)
+    assert tuple(layer.w_s.shape) == (N, K // G) and layer.w_s.dtype == act_type
+
+    x = (0.5 * torch.randn((M, K), device=device)).to(act_type)
+    bias = torch.randn((N,), device=device).to(act_type)
+    out = kernel.apply_weights(layer, x, bias)
+
+    zf = 8.0 if z is None else z.float().repeat_interleave(G, 0)
+    w_ref = (q.float() - zf) * s.float().repeat_interleave(G, 0)  # [K, N]
+    ref = x.float() @ w_ref + bias.float()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.float(), ref, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+def test_aiter_w4a16_symmetric_ignores_qzeros():
+    """GPTQ registers qzeros even for uint4b8 (zero_points=False)."""
+    set_random_seed(0)
+    K, N, G, M = 256, 256, 128, 8
+    q = torch.randint(0, 16, (K, N), device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    s = (0.02 * torch.rand((K // G, N), device=device)).to(torch.float16)
+    z = torch.zeros((K // G, N), device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    layer = _make_layer("gptq", q, s, z)
+    kernel = AiterW4A16LinearKernel(
+        _config(K, N, G, scalar_types.uint4b8, torch.float16, False),
+        w_q_param_name="w_q",
+        w_s_param_name="w_s",
+        w_zp_param_name="w_zp",
+    )
+    kernel.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    x = torch.randn((M, K), device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
+    out = kernel.apply_weights(layer, x)
+    ref = x.float() @ ((q.float() - 8) * s.float().repeat_interleave(G, 0))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.float(), ref, rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "group_size,weight_type,ok",
+    [
+        (128, scalar_types.uint4b8, True),
+        (64, scalar_types.uint4, True),
+        (-1, scalar_types.uint4b8, True),
+        (48, scalar_types.uint4b8, False),
+        (128, scalar_types.uint8b128, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_aiter_w4a16_can_implement(monkeypatch, group_size, weight_type, ok):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rocm_aiter_ops, "is_linear_w4a16_enabled", classmethod(lambda cls: True)
+    )
+    c = _config(1536, 512, group_size, weight_type, torch.bfloat16, False)
+    assert AiterW4A16LinearKernel.can_implement(c)[0] == ok
+
+
+def test_aiter_w4a16_warmup_m_values():
+    from vllm.model_executor.warmup.aiter_w4a16_warmup import _warmup_m_values
+
+    m = _warmup_m_values(300)
+    assert m[0] == 1 and m[-1] == 300
+    assert {2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 15, 16, 31, 32, 255, 256, 299} <= set(m)
+    assert all(1 <= v <= 300 for v in m)
+
+
+def test_aiter_w4a16_warmup_runs_each_shape_once():
+    """Layers sharing weight shapes compile one set of M values; the kernel
+    is found on quant_method (GPTQ/AWQ) and on scheme (compressed-tensors)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.warmup.aiter_w4a16_warmup import (
+        _warmup_m_values,
+        aiter_w4a16_warmup,
+    )
+
+    K, G = 256, 128
+    calls = []
+
+    class CountingKernel(AiterW4A16LinearKernel):
+        def apply_weights(self, layer, x, bias=None):
+            calls.append(x.shape[0])
+            return super().apply_weights(layer, x, bias)
+
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    for i, (N, owner) in enumerate(
+        [(128, "quant_method"), (128, "quant_method"), (256, "scheme")]
+    ):
+        q = torch.randint(0, 16, (K, N), device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        s = (0.02 * torch.rand((K // G, N), device=device)).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        layer = _make_layer("gptq", q, s, None)
+        kernel = CountingKernel(
+            _config(K, N, G, scalar_types.uint4b8, torch.bfloat16, False),
+            w_q_param_name="w_q",
+            w_s_param_name="w_s",
+        )
+        kernel.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+        setattr(layer, owner, type("Owner", (), {"kernel": kernel})())
+        model.add_module(f"layer{i}", layer)
+
+    aiter_w4a16_warmup(model, max_tokens=64)
+    assert calls == _warmup_m_values(64) * 2
+
+
+def test_aiter_w4a16_rejects_batch_invariant(monkeypatch):
+    import vllm.envs as envs
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rocm_aiter_ops, "is_linear_w4a16_enabled", classmethod(lambda cls: True)
+    )
+    # setattr before setenv, so monkeypatch restores the unset value.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(envs, "VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", True)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", "1")
+    c = _config(1536, 512, 128, scalar_types.uint4b8, torch.bfloat16, False)
+    ok, reason = AiterW4A16LinearKernel.can_implement(c)
+    assert not ok
+    assert reason is not None and "batch invariant" in reason

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""W4A16 GEMM for ROCm gfx942 (MI300) with AITER's Triton ``gemm_a16w4``.
+
+AITER's ``gemm_a16w4`` (``aiter.ops.triton.gemm.basic.gemm_a16w4``) reads
+int4 weights as plain row-major nibbles along K:
+
+  w:        [N, K // 2]  uint8   byte j of row n = q[n, 2j] | q[n, 2j + 1] << 4
+  w_scales: [N, K // G]  fp16 / bf16
+  w_zeros:  [N, K // G]  uint8   (None: zero point 8, i.e. uint4b8)
+
+The GPTQ/AWQ/compressed-tensors loaders hand the kernel framework int32 words
+holding 8 sequential K values (bit 4*i = value i), so ``w`` is that word
+tensor in [N, K // 8] layout viewed as uint8; no nibble shuffle is needed.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+    unpack_quantized_values_into_int32,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.parameter import BasevLLMParameter, permute_param_layout_
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.scalar_type import scalar_types
+
+from .MPLinearKernel import MPLinearKernel, MPLinearLayerConfig
+
+
+class AiterW4A16LinearKernel(MPLinearKernel):
+    SUPPORTED_QUANT_TYPES = [
+        scalar_types.uint4b8,  # symmetric GPTQ (zero point 8)
+        scalar_types.uint4,  # asymmetric, explicit zero points (AWQ, CT)
+    ]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_min_capability(cls) -> int:
+        # Arch gating is done by rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_w4a16_enabled().
+        return 0
+
+    @classmethod
+    def can_implement(cls, c: MPLinearLayerConfig) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+            return False, "AiterW4A16LinearKernel is ROCm-only"
+
+        if not rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_w4a16_enabled():
+            return (
+                False,
+                "AITER W4A16 GEMM needs VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1, "
+                "VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR=1, gfx942 and an AITER build with "
+                "gemm_a16w4",
+            )
+
+        if envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT:
+            # The tuned BLOCK_SIZE_K (and split-K) changes with the M bucket.
+            return False, "AiterW4A16LinearKernel is not batch invariant"
+
+        if c.weight_type not in cls.SUPPORTED_QUANT_TYPES:
+            return (
+                False,
+                f"Quant type ({c.weight_type}) not supported by "
+                f"AiterW4A16LinearKernel; supported: {cls.SUPPORTED_QUANT_TYPES}",
+            )
+
+        if c.act_type not in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
+            return False, "AiterW4A16LinearKernel supports fp16 and bf16 only"
+
+        K = c.partition_weight_shape[0]
+        if K % 8 != 0:
+            return False, f"Input features ({K}) must be a multiple of 8"
+
+        gs = c.group_size
+        if gs != -1 and gs != K:
+            if gs < 16 or gs & (gs - 1) != 0:
+                return (
+                    False,
+                    f"Group size ({gs}) must be -1 or a power of two >= 16",
+                )
+            if K % gs != 0:
+                return (
+                    False,
+                    f"Group size ({gs}) does not divide input features ({K})",
+                )
+
+        return True, None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        c = self.config
+
+        def transform_w_q(x: BasevLLMParameter) -> torch.Tensor:
+            # [N, K // 8] int32, 8 sequential K values per word -> [N, K // 2]
+            permute_param_layout_(x, input_dim=1, output_dim=0, packed_dim=1)
+            return x.data.contiguous().view(torch.uint8)
+
+        def transform_w_s(x: BasevLLMParameter) -> torch.Tensor:

+

+            zp = unpack_quantized_values_into_int32(x.data, c.weight_type, packed_dim=0)
+            return zp.to(torch.uint8).contiguous()
+
+        self._transform_param(layer, self.w_q_name, transform_w_q)
+        self._transform_param(layer, self.w_s_name, transform_w_s)
+        if c.zero_points:
+            self._transform_param(layer, self.w_zp_name, transform_w_zp)

+        return output.reshape(out_shape)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Compile AITER gemm_a16w4 for every M bucket before serving.
+
+AITER picks a tuned config per power-of-two M bucket (M_LEQ_1 ... M_LEQ_8192,
+then "any"), and Triton further specializes M on M == 1 and M % 16 == 0.
+CUDA graph capture only covers the decode sizes, so prefill chunks would
+otherwise compile new variants during serving.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _warmup_m_values(max_tokens: int) -> list[int]:
+    m_values = {1, max_tokens, max_tokens - 1}
+    b = 2
+    while b <= max_tokens:
+        m_values.update((b, b - 1))
+        b *= 2
+    return sorted(m for m in m_values if 1 <= m <= max_tokens)
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def aiter_w4a16_warmup(model: torch.nn.Module, max_tokens: int) -> None:
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mixed_precision.aiter_w4a16 import (
+        AiterW4A16LinearKernel,
+    )
+
+    m_values = _warmup_m_values(max_tokens)
+    seen = set()
+    x_buf = None
+    for module in model.modules():
+        # GPTQ/AWQ keep the kernel on quant_method, compressed-tensors on scheme.
+        kernels = [
+            getattr(getattr(module, owner, None), "kernel", None)
+            for owner in ("quant_method", "scheme")
+        ]
+        kernel = next(
+            (k for k in kernels if isinstance(k, AiterW4A16LinearKernel)), None
+        )
+        if kernel is None:
+            continue
+        w_q, w_s, w_zp = kernel._get_weight_params(module)
+        bias = (
+            None
+            if getattr(module, "skip_bias_add", False)
+            else getattr(module, "bias", None)
+        )
+        act_type = kernel.config.act_type
+        key = (
+            tuple(w_q.shape),
+            tuple(w_s.shape),
+            w_s.dtype,
+            None if w_zp is None or not kernel.config.zero_points else w_zp.dtype,
+            None if bias is None else bias.dtype,
+            act_type,
+        )
+        if key in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(key)
+        K = kernel.config.partition_weight_shape[0]
+        if x_buf is None or x_buf.shape[1] != K or x_buf.dtype != act_type:
+            x_buf = torch.zeros((max_tokens, K), dtype=act_type, device=w_q.device)
+        for m in m_values:
+            kernel.apply_weights(module, x_buf[:m], bias)
+    if seen:
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        logger.info(
+            "Warmed up AITER gemm_a16w4 for %d weight shapes x %d M values.",
+            len(seen),
+            len(m_values),
